observations: Photo 0 shows the retail box for a Singer HD4432 Heavy Duty table top sewing machine.
The box indicates 110 stitch applications and 110 accessories included.
The actual sewing machine is not visible in the photo; only the packaging is shown.
The box appears to be in a retail or storage environment.

claims.evidence: The box does not specify the intended materials; this is a common marketing claim for this model.

claims.claim: Japanese made, the motor runs smooth. All accessories and the original manual, never serviced because nothing ever went wrong.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The box may be empty or contain a different, lower-value item.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual machine outside of the box.

risks.risk: The machine may be used, refurbished, or have internal mechanical faults.
risks.proof: A video of the machine powered on and performing a stitch test.

risks.risk: Essential accessories like the foot pedal or power cord may be missing.
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories laid out.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual sewing machine outside of the box.
Photo of the machine's serial number plate.
Video of the machine powered on and stitching fabric.
Photo of the foot pedal and power cord.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
